Thanks — happy to run this. Quick note on timezones so we avoid the DST trap: the US already switched to DST on Mar 8 (so Pacific is PDT, Eastern is EDT). The UK switches to BST on Mar 29. That means the same UTC offset changes for UK/Europe around your proposed dates. To be explicit, when you propose Tue 31 Mar 10:00 PT, that is: 10:00 PDT / 13:00 EDT / 17:00 UTC / 18:00 BST.

If it helps, we can lock to UTC in the invite and include local equivalents in the description. For our ops team, Marissa — are you & Dylan available Tue 31 Mar at 10:00 PDT (13:00 EDT / 17:00 UTC / 18:00 BST)?

If not, we can do Wed 1 Apr 09:00 PDT (12:00 EDT / 16:00 UTC / 17:00 BST) — Sophie, note the UTC values are different between these two slots because of the UK DST change on Mar 29.
